intents_zh: direnv 進目錄自動載 env
code:
# .envrc
strict_env

layout python python{{python_version}}

dotenv_if_exists .env
dotenv_if_exists .env.local

export PROJECT_ROOT=$(pwd)
export PYTHONPATH="$PROJECT_ROOT/src:${PYTHONPATH:-}"

path_add PATH "$PROJECT_ROOT/bin"

log_status "loaded $(basename $PROJECT_ROOT)"
summary_zh: direnv .envrc 自動 venv + env 載入
